I am Dr. Agent. Tell me, besides your fatigue, flank pain, and fever, have you noticed any changes in your urination, such as frequency, urgency, or blood?

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Urinalysis: Leukocyturia Present, Bacterial Culture Negative, Cytospin Stained With Hansel's Solution: 3% binucleated cells with eosinophilic, granular cytoplasm; Blood Culture: Normal Readings; Renal Ultrasound: Normal Readings

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Pyelonephritis and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis (likely due to beta-lactam allergy complicating initial treatment)
